status: thresholds unchanged — campaign executed on isolated environment (60 invocations); C1 abandoned; B13 remains FAIL (imports median over budget)

environment.required: isolated PostgreSQL with the representative business schema
forbidden: any environment containing jisra-test sentinel stores
environment.operator_check: verify the connection target before running; the harness cannot read the project ref

initial_state.method: p79_bench_begin() per variant (setup + reset) and p79_bench_teardown() at the end
initial_state.guarantee: A and C start from an identical empty benchmark store; no accumulation across rounds

variants.A: all six KPI producers disabled (including trg_kpi_mark_order_insert)
variants.C: all six KPI producers enabled (P7.9 state)

sections.create_unit: 1 order + 2 items, one statement per iteration
sections.import_bulk: set-based import: 2 INSERT ... SELECT for N orders / 2N items

measurement_coverage.drain_seconds: instrumented if worker enabled, otherwise NOT_COVERED
measurement_coverage.individual_lock_waits: NOT COVERED — requires parallel pg_locks sampling

verdict_rules.PASS_UNDER_BUDGETS: median and p95 within budget on all sections, no deadlock increase
verdict_rules.FAIL: any budget exceeded, deadlock increase, or unexplained financial divergence
verdict_rules.NOT_COVERED: missing lock instrumentation, worker disabled for drain, or scenario not executed

known_limits: psql timing includes client/session overhead shared by both variants (differential measurement)
no per-trigger attribution without EXPLAIN instrumentation
worker is single-flight by design: parallel publication cannot be demonstrated
production runs PostgreSQL 17.6 ARM64 vs test 17.11 x86_64: results are not transferable as-is
a simulated benchmark is never a B13 qualification
